pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, stellate-shaped patches with highly jagged, multi-lobed borders. High edge angularity with sharp pixel-level gradients between dark brown pigmented regions and light interstitial background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes typically involve three to four radiating pathways. Pixel thickness of pathways is non-uniform, widening at several junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D contour consisting of short, stiff vertical hair bundles forming a sawtooth silhouette. Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration against the background.
